license_required.quote: a person or joint venture that undertakes, offers to undertake or submits a bid to do work as a contractor must have a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board and possess an appropriate endorsement

issuing_authority.quote: a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board

type.quote: The Construction Contractors Board is established, consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor

required.quote: A commercial general contractor or commercial specialty contractor shall certify upon license application or renewal that the contractor has one or more key employees with the combined total amount of experience required under ORS 701.084.

experience_source.quote: A commercial general contractor or commercial specialty contractor shall certify upon license application or renewal that the contractor has one or more key employees with the combined total amount of experience required under ORS 701.084.

exams.name: Business practices and laws test
exams.notes: Required for license applicants; the board approves a test measuring knowledge of business practices and laws. Not required for residential or commercial developer endorsement only.
exams.quote: the board, by rule, shall approve a test for applicants for licensing under ORS 701.046. The test shall measure the applicant's knowledge regarding business practices and laws

interval_years.quote: A license is valid for two years from the date of issuance unless the license is revoked or suspended

required.quote: to qualify for the renewal of a residential contractor license the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal

hours_per_period.quote: the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal

period_years.quote: during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal

value: 3 hours: laws, regulations and business practices
5 hours: approved courses (construction business practices, marketing, customer service, accounting, business law, bidding, building codes, safety, energy efficiency, trade specific subjects)
topical_requirements.quote: Three of the hours required under paragraph (a) of this subsection must be education regarding laws, regulations and business practices... Five of the hours required under paragraph (a) of this subsection must be education from approved providers

available.quote: the administrator with approval of the designated examining or advisory board may, when it is in the best interest of the economy of the State of Oregon, enter into a reciprocal agreement with such other state to issue without examination licenses or certificate of registration upon proof of licensing or registration in such other state

requirements.value: Reciprocal agreements may be entered when another state's standards, qualifications and examinations for building trades and mechanical and specialty skills are substantially similar to Oregon's. License issued without examination upon proof of out-of-state licensing and payment of fees.
requirements.quote: the administrator determines that the standards, qualifications and examinations for licensing or registration of building trades and mechanical and specialty skills of another state are substantially similar to the standards, qualifications and examinations required under applicable Oregon statutes

exists.quote: The Construction Contractors Board is established, consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor

is_mandatory.quote: Except as provided in ORS 701.010, a person or joint venture that undertakes, offers to undertake or submits a bid to do work as a contractor must have a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board

title_protection.quote: Violation of ORS 701.021 is a Class A misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Except as provided in ORS 701.010, a person or joint venture that undertakes, offers to undertake or submits a bid to do work as a contractor must have a current license issued by the Construction Contractors Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a provision of the Construction Contractors chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a rule or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule or order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entered into a settlement agreement but failed to comply with its terms.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered into a settlement agreement with another person under ORS 701.145 but failed to comply with the terms of the settlement agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Owner/officer of a business entity previously subject to revocation, suspension, or civil/criminal penalty related to construction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a business entity or is the owner, director, officer or partner of a business entity... that was subject to a revocation or suspension of a license, or subject to a civil or criminal penalty, imposed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitted an application that was incomplete, incorrect, or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitted an application to the board that, at the time the board issued or renewed the license or denied the application, was incomplete in any material respect or included a statement that was incorrect or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money, causing a lien to be filed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to a person and the failure caused the person to file a lien on a structure under ORS 87.001 to 87.093.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly provided false information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly provided false information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked without a required construction permit resulting in a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint being filed with the board under ORS 701.139.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of specified serious crimes (murder, assault, kidnapping, rape, etc.).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Was convicted, or an owner, director, officer or partner of the licensee or applicant was convicted, consistent with ORS 670.280, of one of the following crimes in this state or an equivalent crime in another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay for labor or materials under a public improvement contract within 90 days of receiving payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Did not pay another person for supplying labor or materials contracted for under a public improvement contract, plus the amount of interest due, within 90 days after receiving payment from a contracting agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment against contractors or subcontractors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonest or fraudulent conduct as a contractor injurious to the public welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that was dishonest or fraudulent and that the board finds injurious to the welfare of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hired employees while licensed as exempt.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Hired employees while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.

bonding_required.quote: An applicant for issuance or renewal of a contractor license shall file with the Construction Contractors Board a surety bond with one or more corporate sureties authorized to do business in this state

insurance_required.quote: A contractor who possesses a license as required under this chapter shall have in effect public liability, personal injury and property damage insurance covering the work of the contractor

definition_quote.value: A 'specialty contractor' means a contractor who performs work on a structure, project, development or improvement and whose operations as such do not fall within the definition of 'general contractor.' 'Specialty contractor' includes a person who performs work regulated under ORS 446.395.
definition_quote.quote: "Specialty contractor" means a contractor who performs work on a structure, project, development or improvement and whose operations as such do not fall within the definition of "general contractor."

hvac_specific_experience_required.quote: A commercial general contractor or commercial specialty contractor shall certify upon license application or renewal that the contractor has one or more key employees with the combined total amount of experience required under ORS 701.084.

qualifier_required.quote: A business licensed under this chapter must at all times have at least one responsible managing individual.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: A contractor or business may operate with a temporary responsible managing individual for the earlier of 14 days after giving the notification or until the date on which the contractor or business receives notice that the board has approved an individual to be the responsible managing individual

value: letter of credit (for nonprofit rehabilitating illegal drug manufacturing sites)
cash deposit (for nonprofit rehabilitating illegal drug manufacturing sites)
financial_responsibility_demonstration_m.quote: An applicant for issuance or renewal of a contractor license shall file with the Construction Contractors Board a surety bond with one or more corporate sureties authorized to do business in this state

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: A person that is within the exempt class described in subsection (2)(b) of this section and is licensed as a commercial contractor shall procure and maintain workers' compensation insurance as authorized by ORS 656.128.

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: A contractor who possesses a license as required under this chapter shall have in effect public liability, personal injury and property damage insurance covering the work of the contractor

small_project_exemption_threshold_dollar.quote: A person working on one structure or project, under one or more contracts, when the aggregate price of all of that person's contracts for labor, materials and all other items is less than $1,000 and such work is of a casual, minor or inconsequential nature.

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: the contractor shall provide the contractor's license number and state that the license is in full force and effect... The city, county or state agency shall list the contractor's license number on the permit issued to that contractor.

scope_expansion_by_rule_authorized.quote: The Construction Contractors Board may adopt rules to make licensure optional for persons who offer, bid or undertake to perform work peripheral to construction, as defined by administrative rule of the board.
